description: Agent discovery experience - sorting, tagging, and enhanced browsing for public agents

userStories.title: Backend: Add tags field to Assistant and PublicAssistant schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Assistant model to support tags so agents can be categorized and filtered.
acceptanceCriteria: Assistant model has tags: list[str] = [] field
PublicAssistant projection includes tags field
PublicAssistant.from_assistant() maps tags correctly
Existing tests pass (make test)
Lint passes (make format && make lint)

userStories.title: Backend: Add sort_by and tags params to public search endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sort and filter public agents so I can find the most relevant ones quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /assistants/public accepts sort_by query param (fork_count, updated_at, published_at)
Default sort_by is published_at (backwards compatible)
GET /assistants/public accepts tags query param (comma-separated string)
Tags filter returns agents matching ANY of the provided tags
sort_by=fork_count returns agents ordered by fork_count descending
Existing tests pass (make test)
userStories.notes: Modify search_public() in backend/src/services/assistant.py and route in backend/src/routes/v0/assistant.py

userStories.title: Frontend: Enhanced Discover tab with sorting and tag display
userStories.description: As a user browsing public agents, I want a Discover tab with sorting and tag chips so I can find interesting agents to remix.
acceptanceCriteria: Discover tab shows public agents (rename or add to existing public-agents tab)
Sort dropdown with options: Most Remixed, Newest, Recently Updated
Agent cards display tag chips below description
AgentService.listPublic() accepts sortBy and tags parameters
Typecheck passes (npm run build)
userStories.notes: Agent index at frontend/src/pages/agents/index.tsx. AgentService at frontend/src/lib/services/agentService.ts.

userStories.title: Frontend: Tag editing in assistant editor
userStories.description: As an agent creator, I want to add tags when editing my agent so it appears in relevant searches.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent edit form includes a tags input (comma-separated or chip input)
Tags are saved with the assistant on update
Tags are displayed in the edit form when loading existing agents
Typecheck passes (npm run build)
userStories.notes: Check existing agent edit page for form patterns.

userStories.title: Tests for discovery features
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for sorting and filtering to prevent regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: sort_by=fork_count returns correctly ordered results
Test: tags filter returns matching agents
Test: empty tags filter returns all agents
All tests pass (make test)
Lint passes (make format && make lint)
